protocol.purpose: Exploratory measurement only; no selector training or validation claims

boundary_cluster.distance_metric: Euclidean distance in the same local lon/lat plane as the exact query
boundary_cluster.generation: Uniform proposals in the unchanged extent; reject distances greater than 0.002 degrees; retain first 4000 covered and first 4000 uncovered band points, then combine with 2000 ordinary uniform points and randomly permute the 10000 random records

timing.whole_batch: One outer perf_counter_ns interval containing fresh preparation and K consecutive calls of the unchanged query function; each call constructs a new result array
timing.correctness: Preflight and post-batch ID comparisons outside the timed interval; immutable coordinates during benchmark
timing.feature_only: RNG initialization, random sampling without replacement, sample coordinate gathering, independent r6/r7/r8 encoding, within-resolution cell deduplication, sample-cell polygons and covers/intersects classification
timing.feature_common_geometry: Fresh geometry preparation measured separately, before feature-only timer
timing.warmup: One fresh preparation and one query per method/dataset; one feature extraction per dataset, all outside recorded trials
timing.gc: Disabled uniformly during measured trials, restored afterwards

posthoc_comparisons.selection_basis: Minimum median of actually measured preparation-plus-K totals for each dataset and K; not a deployable selector
posthoc_comparisons.potential_saving: two-choice minimum median minus four-choice minimum median
